verdict.rationale: First-party docs state customers can run Datalab's models on infrastructure they control under an Enterprise contract, aimed at data-privacy and regulated environments. Air-gapped deployment is listed on the pricing page, and docs cover an on-prem container with a maintained Helm chart (v1.2.0) for Kubernetes plus a lightweight surya on-prem container type; the open-source Marker, Surya, and Chandra models remain free to self-host. missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of on-prem deployments, the managed stack is gated behind an Enterprise contract, and there is no explicit VPC-specific deployment guidance in the evidence.
